S4 E20 — The One With All The Wedding DressesA snoring Joey is keeping Chandler awake, forcing Chandler to take him to a sleep clinic. Ross asks Monica to pick up Emily's wedding dress for him, and Monica decides to try it on.
S4 E21 — The One With The InvitationRoss and Emily discuss who to invite to their wedding. He wants to invite Rachel while Emily thinks it's odd.
S9 E22 — Frasier Has SpokaneWhen Frasier's radio show is syndicated in Spokane and replaces the local radio icon's show, his callers are angry, to say the least.

S9 E23 — The Guilt TrippersNiles surprises Daphne with a trip to Hawaii. However Mrs Moon falls into a state of total despair about her failed marriage, and Daphne feels bad about leaving her alone for the weekend.

S16 E58 — Episode 58Develop your prowess in the kitchen with one of Australia’s most loved cooks, Justine Schofield. Along with an array of amazing guests Justine inspires cooks of all skill levels to be more ambitious and creative in their kitchens.
S4 E17 — Picture ImperfectBecker is published in a prestigious medical journal, but the photo accompanying the article isn't him; Linda goes on a date with the water deliveryman.
S10 E2 — Enemy At The GateFrasier gets into an argument with his parking garage attendant that makes a mountain from a molehill.
S10 E3 — Proxy PrexyFrasier is desperate to win the presidency of the condo board after several unsuccessful attempts and nominates his more popular father as a figurehead.

S5 E6 — The One With The YetiMonica and Rachel are afraid of a hairy new neighbour until he gets a haircut. Phoebe is surprised that she enjoys wearing mink. Ross confronts Emily and refuses to stop associating with Rachel.
S5 E7 — The One Where Ross Moves InAfter getting kicked out of his apartment, Ross moves in temporarily with Chandler and Joey, driving all three of them crazy. Phoebe dates a health inspector.
S5 E8 — The One With All The ThanksgivingsThe gang reminisce past terrible Thanksgiving experiences, and Chandler tells Monica that he loves her.

S5 E9 — The One With Ross's SandwichRoss becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it. Joey finds himself in a terrible mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

S2 E8 — Frankenstein And The Horny VillagersAlan gets carried away with a woman he met at the supermarket, and it's up to Charlie to talk some sense into him while shielding Jake and Judith from what's going on.
S2 E9 — Yes, MonsignorCharlie runs into a newly-divorced ex, now a single mum, who's willing to give him another shot. Back home, Jake tries to diagnose his learning problems.
S2 E10 — The Salmon Under My SweaterCharlie struggles to write a jingle for a new cartoon. Meanwhile, Alan spends time with Rose, and Jake procrastinates doing a book report.

p.t: Why The Heck Did I Buy This House
p.d: Spanning four generations, a mother and her two sons love their 110-year-old San Antonio home, but it's in desperate need of a renovation. Kim and her team are tasked with bringing this legacy house into the 21st century while honoring its historic past.

It's winter and a snow shower has turned the Chateau into an icy palace - with a load of gardening jobs attached! Despite Dick and Angel's never ending 'to do' list, there's still time for the Strawbridge family to make snow angels, challenge each other to a snowball fight and collect the very first super-sized goose eggs of the season.

A young married couple decides to leave Canada in search of a more laid-back lifestyle in Costa Rica; they're looking to put down roots in Ojochal, but a surprise pregnancy has them moving faster than expected to find the right place.

A twenty-something amateur wood worker wants to take on a project for her first home in Burlington, Vermont. Her BFF is worried she'll get in over her head and hopes to steer her toward something more updated.

Young newlyweds and cat parents look to get a dog, start a family and buy their first home in Seattle. He's looking for a sleek and updated midcentury modern, but she prefers a place that's vintage and quirky where she can express herself.

Erin's friend and former bandmate is recently divorced and needs to make a new start in his old home. Ben and Erin transform his spartan bachelor pad into the moody, customized house he always dreamed of.

Mina and the team take on a four-dwelling new build consisting of a duplex and a carriage house. But when things go wrong with the foundation of the duplex, the focus shifts to executing the carriage house so it can begin earning rental income.
Jasmine struggles to find a new studio as she helps a newly divorced mom.

Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
After being released from the mental hospital, Dr. Sturgis unexpectedly breaks up with Meemaw.
Two baby white rhinos join the herd at The Wilds; a pair of red pandas have a blind date in a tree; and a super-cute tortoise baffles its doctors.

When the Great Dragon attacks Camelot, Merlin must go on an epic journey to find the one man who can defeat the monster.

A plane ticket snafu results in the Huangs missing their flight to D.C. to celebrate Lunar New Year with family. They try local alternatives with mixed results before friends help them ring in their traditional new year.
After Dr Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path.
When Team Rocket turns a flock of Taillow against our heroes, an old friend comes to the rescue!

Are you squeamish? Find out why in today's lab experiment and get ready to get moving in Investigation Ouch! The Doctors tackle medical mysteries on the wards in Ouch & About and we meet two more new Ouch Patients.
On the Bears' visit to a medieval vegetable-village, Grizz starts to believe that he's the rightful king.
Panda volunteers to be Lucy's partner for a dance contest.
Robin starts doing power moves with Cyborg.
When Mike hears eerie singing and glowing lights in the sea near the lighthouse, he calls Agent Price and Agent Sparkes to check it out.

Ten turns up to tell the team what it's like to be a perfect ten-block. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten!

Rachael and Teo are building a home for termites to keep them out of the rain! Special guest Sean Choolburra plays insect noises on his didgeridoo and helps tell a story of a hungry termite.

p.d: When the Rickety Old Bridge collapses, trapping Toby and Henrietta on the other side of the ravine, Inventor Ruth is asked to build a new one.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can't see. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale. Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa, and each of her friends, bring in an old toy but they soon realise that favourite toys can be hard to let go of.
Lou starts a song and everyone joins in - everyone except Mitch the giant sloth, who is trying to nap.
Ginger is leading the Baby Pea-Rexes home through a shortcut and gets lost, refusing to admit defeat, she suggests they find an even better bed to spend the night!
Holly shrinks Lucy down so she can play in the Little Kingdom. She has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
When Fergie is feeling off, Vida diagnoses her - she's having a sad day.
While the team battles Gor-don, Ginger discovers the Heroes' secret and makes a homemade super-suit to join the fight.
The crew help Capt. Sprinkles find a flower to make his special cupcakes but when Escarlata steals it they must get it back.
Gekko tries to get Pirate Robot to be a chef instead of a pirate.
When a school of flying fish accidentally make off with a rare book belonging to Professor Inkling, the Octonauts rig up the Gup-B to fly after them and get it back.
The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they can not identify. With Duggee's help they learn all about sound and how to listen for different qualities in the noises they hear.

Lisa McKnight, Mattel’s chief brand officer, has been at the forefront of reviving the iconic Barbie. Now the famous toy brand has launched itself beyond store shelves and onto the silver screen.

A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

A groundbreaking operation is happening at the Bondi clinic: Elroy, the out-of-control bulldog is being desexed, and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen. There are some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that's wandered way off track.

On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner. Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi's most delightful dog-loving eccentrics, and a cutting-edge solution for a record-breaking goat.
Dr Chris desperately fights to save the life of an innocent hit and run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite. And, a lorikeet learns to fly again.

A much-loved Labrador is in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five-month-old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

It's an unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him: will the joey make it without his mum? Plus, a helping hand for a puppy with a life-threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy: a chihuahua with a mean streak.
Follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners' lives. Lisa struggles to save the life of a pregnant beagle. And, a bunny brings the Bondi vet to tears.

So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

Chris tackles a tricky rescue—a mother duck and her three ducklings are stuck in a rubbish-filled pool at a building site. One duckling's already died, and catching these submersive birds won't be easy.
An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping center mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

Chris faces one of his most traumatic nights when Bella the pug is rushed in. She's in labour with six huge pups, and during an emergency caesarean, Chris and his team battle to save the babies and critical Bella.
Kooky cousins fear Marie the Pomeranian swallowed bikini string. Chris diagnoses while they redecorate the clinic, then operates—cue a whacky homecoming.

It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth. Dinosaurs dominated for 150 million years, but they weren't alone.

Like animals, the lives of plants are a race to grow and breed, to make sure they leave a genetic legacy. They must race to beat their communities to the best light spots or to make the most of short seasons. And to breed some catapult offspring around the forest, some use the wind.

We think of plants as inanimate objects, but they are anything but. Plants have cunning tricks, from shedding their leaves to producing antifreeze to escape the weather. They will cover themselves in thorns and produce toxic chemicals to try and defend themselves from animals that want to eat them.

Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

p.t: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
p.d: Overachiever Ellie teams with slacker Nate to sabotage her ex in the class election, but unexpected sparks threaten her meticulously laid plans.
Three sisters return to their childhood home for a momentous occasion: the third wedding of their twice-widowed mother.
Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world's 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.

Convinced his wife is trapped inside, a soldier infiltrates a high-tech facility where reality and illusion blur in a surreal, futuristic fantasy park. As he navigates this seductive and dangerous world, a shocking truth pulls him into a deadly game.
Follows two Brit police officers Thomas Wilkin and Geoffrey Morton in their hunt for charismatic poet and Zionist freedom fighter Avraham Stern, who was plotting to evict British authorities.

Renowned musician Lydia Tár is days away from recording the symphony that will elevate her career. When all elements seem to conspire against her, Lydia's adopted daughter Petra becomes an integral emotional support for her struggling mother.
Father Gabriele Amorth, chief exorcist of the Vatican, uncovers a centuries-old conspiracy while investigating a young boy's terrifying possession.
Old tensions resurface when former bandmates who were former lovers reunite for a private show at the island home of an eccentric millionaire.

Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.
Chronicling Jacinda Ardern's tenure as New Zealand PM, navigating crises while redefining global leadership through her empathetic yet resolute approach.

When Jonah calls in to a talk-radio program to find a new wife for his father, Sam grudgingly gets on the line to discuss his feelings. Annie Reed, a reporter in Baltimore, hears Sam speak and falls for him, even though she is engaged. Unsure where it will lead, she writes Sam a letter asking him to meet her at the Empire State Building on Valentine's Day.

A pilot is selected to attend the Top Gun Naval Flying School while also pursuing a relationship with an instructor.
A young woman tries to ease the pain of her fiance's death by sending texts to his old cell phone number, and forms a connection with the man the number has been reassigned to.
Archaeologists awaken an Egyptian priest mummified alive 36 centuries ago for killing Pharaoh Seti and sleeping with his mistress. When he escapes from the tomb, he becomes a threat to the world.
A slick, young Navy lawyer is assigned to investigate a murder case in which two Marines killed a fellow enlisted man, and no one's talking.
A soldier searches for his missing wife, infiltrating a facility he believes is tied to trafficking, only to find it's a futuristic park blurring reality and illusion.
In a twist to the fairy tale, the evil Queen Ravenna orders the Huntsman to capture Snow White so she can rule eternally; however, he trains her in the art of war to defeat the wicked ruler.
After a devastating betrayal, kind-hearted Queen Freya unleashes dark powers and wages war on love, claiming warriors Eric and Sara as victims.

p.d: In Kazakhstan, a convoy carrying advanced nanotech warheads is attacked. Rescued by an elite military unit, two soldiers join the team as they track a criminal group behind the assault, uncovering a deeper conspiracy.```.

p.d: S4 E7The Grenade Team kicks off their European Vacation by flying to the French Alps for the Kumi Yama snowboard competition. The team meets up with the newest member of Grenade, Eero Niemela. Dingo throws down the gauntlet saying hes going to pull off a front side 720 in the competition. A huge fight erupts when Danny throws water on the Dingo while hes sleeping.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Kumi Yama
p.d: S4 E8Its the morning of the Kumi Yama snowboard competition and Dingo is nowhere to be found, leaving his team without a rider. After a couple runs, Dingo eventually shows up and both teams compete in the contest. While hitting the jumps after the competition, Danny suffers a bad injury.
S1 E6Featured in this episode Carey Hart in Vegas, the Metal Mulisha and travel with Dustin Miller to his place in Nevada and compound in California to check his style.

S1 E7The fuse has been lit, and Fuel TV's first show dedicated strictly to freestyle motocross has arrived. This episode features the rider with arguably the best 'whip' in freestyle motocross, JEFF TILTON -- watch him rip up some demos across the country and hit some natural terrain with Clowers and Herron. Also, meet metal mulisha freestyler Ox, and catch a section saluting failed backflip attempts.

S1 E4Follow Jeremy Seewer in his quest to win his home GP in Switzerland and be with him throughout the Highs and Lows of the Grand Prix! Included too in the BTG are the Highlights of the MXGP of Switzerland presented by iXS along with a special focus on another Swiss Rider, JK Racing's Kevin Brumann.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Learning from the Best
p.d: S1 E2The Norco Race Division is back at it after a tough opening weekend of the UCI Downhill World Cup in Fort William, Scotland. Greg Minnaar is back on the bike, still carrying an injury. All eyes are on Gracey Hemstreet, the young gun who has some very experienced support guiding her along the way.

The Wildcats are back and better than ever with their first film in a decade. This installment of the OG Wildcats crew showcases their present day skills on and off the hill and in famed snowboarding locales: B.C., Japan, and Chile. With Devun Walsh, Ryan Tiene, Iikka Backstrom, Charles Reid, Eero Niemela, Benji Ritchie, and many more.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Race
p.d: S3 E2After a long day of driving the crew settles in for some traditional ostrich racing. Pottz and Pat race to the final when tragedy strikes. Lucky to be alive the crew head back to the coast and continue there way up to Jeffreys bay.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - Shark Beach
p.d: S3 E3Donavon parts with the crew to play a concert at the Billabong Jeffreys Bay WCT event. Meanwhile the others start the drive up with the gear and hopefully to find surf along the way. On their way to Jeffreys Bay, the Drive Thru crew has their first shark experience. They come across an ocean alive with both waves and marine life. Whales , dolphins, schools of fish, and yes, a shark. Pat spots it first and the rest of the crew is in a panic to make it to the beach.

S1 E10Shannon and Shayne explore the little known island of Sumba, Indonesia to surf perfect waves, discover a blossoming humanitarian effort, and as is custom in Sumba, joust on Horses.
S1 E3As Tony's temper gets the best of him, Miles loses his money, and Tyler is still without his bags.

Jason, Grant and the TAPS team head to New England to answer a call from a terrified family plagued by mysterious apparitions. During their investigation, TAPS uncovers some shocking evidence of paranormal activity in the home. From there, they take on claims at the Palace Theater in Manchester, NH, a former vaudeville stop.

The Taps team heads to the coasts to tackle with two investigations. First they travel to Massachusetts to visit the Colonial Inn at Cape Cod. Then they head over to California to investigate the Moss Beach Distillery.

Grant, Jason and the TAPS team head to New Jersey for their next investigation into the paranormal as they spend the night in the home of the last royal governor and look for evidence of hauntings before they examine the Red Mill Museum.

TAPS embarks on an investigation at Fort Delaware, built in the mid-1800?s and primarily used as an artillery defense for the Union during the Civil War. It eventually became a Civil War POW camp, housing over 33,000 Confederate soldiers. The conditions at Fort Delaware were grim, and it soon gained a reputation in the Confederacy as a ?black hole.?

A local preservation society took over this property in 2000, and discovered over 30 boxes of unclaimed human remains tucked away in the basement bathroom. Renovations unearthed remnants of the Episcopal church as well as light fixtures and stained glass that'd been hidden behind the walls and ceilings as if the original funeral director created a building within a building.

TAPS goes to Connecticut to unravel the mysteries at the historic Pettibone Tavern. Built in 1780, the tavern originally served as a carriage stop between Albany and Boston during the late 18th century. During this time, it was also supposedly the site of a brutal axe murder, and through the years, employees have consistently reported activity that they cannot explain.
TAPS visits a 16th century North Kingstown, R.I., landmark to solve an awful mystery. Then, TAPS comes to help a military family living in Groton, Conn.

TAPS visits the abandoned (and skeevy) remains of an art-deco masterpiece, Buffalo Central Terminal. The terminal, a 14-story combination office tower/train station, opened in 1929 and closed 50 years later. After falling through the hands of various owners, the Central Terminal Restoration Corp. acquired it in 1997. In the years since the Terminal's abandonment, it has become a potent source of paranormal stories.

TAPS is in Florida to investigate an inn that is a hotbed of paranormal activity. This unique St. Petersburg property consists of two multi-story Victorian manors: the Pink House and the Purple House. They were both built in the late 1800s, and are believed to house more than just customers.

Paranormal investigators Grant Wilson and Jason Hawes attempt to find evidence of supernatural activity at a plantation home where a tour group consisting of 35 visitors claim to have witnessed a candlestick flying across the room.

Heather Tracy and her family moved into her ancestor's property two years ago. There were always reports of odd activity and it soon became apparent to her that there was something more to the stories.

TAPS investigates a landmark pool hall in team member Steve Gonsalves' hometown. Over the years, the first floor fronted several retail clients, but is now a tavern called Theodore's. Though two separate establishments, Theodore's and Smith's have a common problem; they both experience intense paranormal activity. Now, their owners are working together and asking TAPS to diagnose their decades-old problem.

TAPS returns to investigate another legendary haunted naval landmark--the aircraft carrier USS Hornet in Alameda, CA. The Hornet, the eighth vessel to carry her name, was commissioned at the height of World War II in 1943. She quickly became one of the most highly decorated ships in the Navy and the USS Hornet is considered the most haunted ship in the Navy, past or present.
TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse.
Josh Gates hosts a roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS in the Soldiers’ Barracks of Fort Delaware.

This series showcases a variety of uniquely Christian Kiwi content produced at Fantail Studios. Jared shares his heart behind them and the call that God has for each of us in sharing testimonies and to seek His Kingdom.

Canada Out of Doors highlights the adventures of Northern Ontario tourism outfitter and seaplane pilot Joel Theriault from Air Ivanhoe. Joel has been guiding fishermen since the age of 6, hunters since the age of 16. Watch Joel and his friends tackle exciting work projects at remote outpost cottages, fish and hunt after a hard day's work, and creatively prepare meals with the fish and game they find. This TV series is a blend of flying, exploring, construction and renovations, camp life, fishing, hunting, and cooking of wild game.

Matt Manzari is a self-described adrenaline junkie. From a young age, he thrived in his family’s adventurous lifestyle, so it’s not surprising that Matt became a world-class professional athlete in the dangerous sport of wake boarding. Even a tragic, nearly fatal accident requiring months of recovery could not keep Matt away from the water. That was just the beginning of his story. As young newlyweds with a baby on the way, Matt and his wife Bobbye Jean experienced another tragic accident, only this time a miracle seemed impossible. The second accident, an encounter with 14,000 volts of electricity (the equivalent of six electric chairs) left Matt burnt beyond recognition and lying at death’s doorstep. Bobbye prepared to say goodbye along with close friends and family. However, miracles started to become a way of life for Matt, who saw God’s hand in every step. In this inspiring documentary, Matt tells his unbelievable story of survival and how, through it, God’s power was perfected in

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.

Powerful, life filled topics are presented in an enjoyable and proven format. Hosts, Brendon and Cathie have poured their 30 years of experience with kids in schools and in ministry and the great goals of the local church into a energetic show that will engage the next generation.

Connect follows a plucky school theatre group that aspires to stage every book of the Bible. The kids are pretty sure they have a clear understanding of everything that happens in 'God's Big Story'. Well…most of it.
The kids make a plan of escape, while Commander Gnorm schemes to discover a secret.
Magnify the King of Glory above every storm, letting His perfect peace guard your heart and quiet every anxious thought in your mind.
Gary Hoogvliet, a very tall man, interviews interesting folk, not quite as tall as he, but nevertheless with fascinating and inspiring stories to tell.

Becoming a mother is a huge adjustment at any stage and navigating parenthood alongside other life circumstances can be incredibly overwhelming. Post Natal Depression affects 1 in 5 mothers in Australia and is an important topic that often goes unspoken. The Be That team discuss the journey through PND and how to best support those who are navigating their way to recovery. With guest, Janelle Spies.
When Little Jack falls ill, Elizabeth and Nathan care for him together as Hickam and Mei race to secure medicine. The kids broadcast a baseball game over the radio to lift spirits.

Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexico's forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

Get cozy with three special rescue dogs vying to be the Chambers family’s new addition. Tag along as Beverley hooks them up with Abby, Liam, and Takaro, three sweet Lab mixes who have all the energy and love required to win them over.

Meet best friends Tammy and Allie, who are living the dream at Wendigo Farms, with a new business, beautiful horses, and a state-of-the-art barn. Learn why running this operation isn’t all peaches and cream once harsh reality rears its ugly head.

Wake up and smell the drama as Allie cooks up a plan that’s way out of line. Meet the friend she hires without telling business manager Tammy and barn manager Megan, and feel the tension as this decision undermines the trust they’ve established.
Watch Dr. Scott’s work life and home life collide when he discovers that his own dog needs surgery. And meet the feisty felines that put the clinic’s new vet, Phoebe, to the test.

Travel north with Dr. Scott to help a donkey sanctuary whose owners were caught up in the Manchester bombings. Meanwhile, a beloved pug may have a potentially fatal tumour and the clinic deals with a nervous border collie.

Welcome a fresh start, in puppy form, with Mike and Kian after a tragic house fire. Go with Beverley to see Weimaraners, English springer spaniels, and Dobermans, then discover which sweet bundle of fluff makes a surprise connection with the pair.
Beverley Mahood meets with the Bier family, who are looking for their first puppy for their three young daughters. The Biers visit the Miniature Poodle, Miniature Golden Doodle and a Bearded Collie.

Meet a brave little shih tzu facing a serious medical challenge and a beagle whose experiments with flying haven’t gone to plan. Later, listen in as the veterinary staff try to sweet-talk Dr. Scott into adopting a clinic cat.

Discover why Harry the tabby cat needs a sex-change operation and find out how the clinic can offer relief to an ailing woman and her tiny terrier. Later, meet a sweet-natured sproodle that Dr. Scott diagnoses with a rare eye condition.

Temperatures are beginning to get much colder in the region, but things start heating up for Hope; an elusive creature is caught on video footage; a dramatic rescue mission takes place after an impaled gull is discovered.

Staff at the zoo know it’s important to feed the minds of the animals too. From puzzles and piñatas to honey tubes and herb gardens, explore the activities zookeepers introduce to help keep boredom at bay.
How do you feed the animals that swim, dip, and dive? See how the zookeepers dole out buckets of fish for the sea lions and penguins, and present bouquets of veggies to the century-old tortoises.

Feeding critically endangered species is an incredibly critical task. When you’re feeding animals teetering on the edge of extinction, every bite counts. See how zoo staff nourishes orangutans, cheetahs, and painted dogs.
Zookeepers can’t let their guards down when it comes to feeding dangerous species. Learn the strategies zoo staff employ to feed ferocious hunters such as tigers, sun bears, and rhinos.

Experience the heat of competition as Allie goes up against an old rival at Wendigo Farms’ first equestrian event. Then feel the tension skyrocket when she discovers that Megan has forgotten an important saddle back at the farm.

On this episode of MythBusters, the whole team comes out all guns blazing as they take aim at Hollywood Gunslingers.

The MythBusters have counted down to lift off and lit the fuse on approximately 960 rockets and fireworks. In this Rocket Special Adam and Jamie are tackling the all time fan favourite explosive technology in a one mega-myth in-depth episode.
Stand by for some ballistic backyard bedlam and a gruesome glass guillotine in an episode devoted to accidental ammo!

Special effects experts Adam and Jamie use several experiments to put an old Hollywood lighting myth to the test; Tory, Kari and Grant experiment with different ways that someone could stop cars that have gone out of control.

Just when you think Adam and Jamie have tested every gun legend in history, they come up with three more myths. All have a real-life history, and some have since been adapted for the movies. Meantime, Kari, Grant and Tori go to great lengths to see whether mankind's first and simplest tool could be far more dangerous than you think.

In Sounds Bogus Adam and Jamie once again take on La La Land. Then Kari, Tory and Grant conquer a classic cartoon conundrum. Becalmed in the doldrums the animated hero pulls out an electric fan, whips up a wind and hey presto he’s off.
Myths tested: Can a hurricane blow a piece of straw through a tree? According to Primary Perception, do all living things share an interconnected consciousness?

On this episode of Mythbusters Adam and Jamie take a fan mail film and use it to dial in on a phone book fable. And then Kari, Grant and Tory test a fishy tale of Hollywood pyrotechnics with their own big bang theories.
Kari, Tory, and Grant risk their lives testing the classic myth—does wearing red really make bulls see red?
Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman reunite to reflect on their adventures on Duct Tape Island, using only the legendary tape to survive and provide a means of rescue. (Final)
In this episode Adam and Jamie and the build team test out separate but similar myths, as they try to float heavy objects in unorthodox fashion. Welcome to the float-athon!
In the myth a car breaks its drive shaft at the front universal joint. The drive shaft drops into a pothole and lifts the car into the air – much like a pole vault.
The Mythbusters head to the ballpark with legendary pitcher Roger Clemens to test classic baseball myths and uncover the science of throwing heat.
On the first Viewer’s Special, Episode #85, we tested a bunch of myths from the fan site, and it was a blast, literally. But fortunately, for every myth we test, our fans have a bunch more.

Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.
The threat of extinction is all too real in the wild, but even against terrible odds, many animals fight back from the brink to continue their empires.

As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.
Witness the harsh realities that shape hippo life on Zambia's Luangwa River.
See what Lewa Conservancy is doing to restore damaged elephant ecosystems.

Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.
Grevy's zebras population has dropped by 50 in less than 20 years. Environmentalists say that if we aren't vigilant, they could disappear all together.
The river really belongs to the hippos. The world's largest concentrations of hippos are found here. They spend their days submerged, keeping cool in the hot sun.
From Cambodia's diverse wildlife to people living in the stilt villages of lake Tonle Sap, the Mekong has dictated the lives of everything that lives there for centuries.
The final country on the Mekong's journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta.Deposits of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam.
See predators and prey live side-by-side in a delicate balance.

The air is thin and cold, trees can’t even live here -­‐ it’s not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. We’ll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.
Discover how lakes, rivers, and marshes are the key to thriving animal life.

Connie wants Steve’s help to stop her daughter Angel from marrying Matt. She claims Matt gave her Angel a black eye, broken nose, concussion, and 3 knocked out teeth. Can Connie reason with Angel and convince her to leave this abusive relationship?
After a young woman runs away from home and has resorted to prostitution to earn money to survive, Steve tries to reconcile her with her family.

Shauna reveals to her fiance that stripping wasn't enough. She also fears that her fiance is not the father of their son! Then, Travis denies that he is the father of Tenisha's kid because he heard that she cheated on him.
Risha is accused of being involved in her best friend's murder; an update on Tabatha, who revealed on the show that her boyfriend allowed her to prostitute so they could get high together.

Loretta and Joseph have been together for 2 years and have a young son together. She says that when she was pregnant, he punched and pulled her hair. She claims that she’s been faithful but Joseph isn’t convinced. Who’s telling the truth?

Josephine's family was ripped apart after her boyfriend Mark was accused of molestation. Her son, Anthony and his girlfriend, Renee believe Mark molested their 2 year old son. But Mark believes that Renee coached her son to say this!
Lisa has had all six of her children REMOVED from her home as a result of neglect and abuse which she still tries to justify.
Eric and Keri accuse Lisa of stalking; Christopher suspects Olivia of cheating again. Drama unfolds!

Destiny says that her daughter has unexplained bruises after visiting Brian. She also says the child told her someone grabbed her neck and threw her against a wall. Brian denies the abuse and believes that it is either Destiny or her boyfriend.

Chante’s daughter accused Danae of sexual abuse. Although Danae was cleared by the authorities, Chante’s mother Shelly never believed her innocence. But is Danae just covering up for her own lies? Did Chante’s mother sleep with her ex-husband?

Kayla says a woman called her and told her that she is sleeping with Kayla's baby's father and may have given him a disease; Javon has not trusted his girlfriend ever since she admitted she cheated with one of his family members.

Julian recently confessed to cheating with Joanna, Linda’s sister-in-law, who actually seduced him. Joanna strongly denies having any affair, and believes Julian is creating the entire event to cover his tracks. Who will Linda believe?

From April: a woman learns on her wedding day that her husband is only 18 years old, and later found out he was verbally and physically abusive; she now suspects he may be having an affair and turns to Steve to find out the truth.
Jeremy seeks redemption, but Julie doubts him, saying he favors his girlfriend’s child over his own.
Steve takes a look back at some of the instances of DNA clearing people's names and some of DNA incriminating people.

p.t: Secret Weapons Of World War II
p.d: During WWII, all sides worked on innovative weapon technologies. Developments like the I400-class, Type XXI submarines and URSEL rocket submarines were crucial for naval warfare.
Examine the story of how dozens of agents were lured to Holland by the Germans, in what is now known as the Dutch Disaster.
Featuring rare archive footage and stunning 3-D computer graphics, this is a privileged glimpse into the world of submarine warfare.

At the request of Russian scientist Dr.

With a narrow margin separating the top four boats and only two weeks left in the season, Captain Ott of Hot Tuna must catch up, while Captain Marciano of Hard Merchandise wants to hold the lead. Captain Carraro risks breaking his season-long streak.

In the last week of the Atlantic bluefin tuna season the closest race in Wicked Tuna history is a tossup between four top contenders - Hot Tuna, Hard Merchandise, FV-Tuna.com and Wicked Pissah - and it will all come down to the final catch! With high-value bluefin paying off at up to $16,000, the leading captains are all one fish away from victory or defeat. And Pinwheel Captain Tyler McLaughlin is desperate for a big score to get him back in the game.

It's the opening week of a new North Atlantic Bluefin tuna season, and for the fishermen of Gloucester, Massachusetts, the summer ahead promises the chance for big fortunes. But fishing for tuna is a gamble and captains and their crews but battle old rivals, new competitors and each other in what will be the most challenging season yet.
After every boat, except the Wicked Pissah, caught fish during the first week, all eyes are on Paul Hebert.

It’s a long-standing tradition in commercial fishing to treat other fishermen with respect, but not every captain plays by the rules. A good deed by Captain Tyler McLaughlin earns the Pinwheel some positive karma. Meanwhile, Captain Dave Carraro, frustrated with the FV-Tuna.com’s dry spell, resorts to desperate measures. But what goes around comes around.

Regardless of whether a captain’s crew is made up of family, friends, longtime partners or greenhorns — the quality of the mates can make or break a season. This year, regulations allow commercial bluefin fishermen to bring in up to five fish per trip, and one boat makes a historic haul that could change the outcome of the entire season.

After his mates succeed without him, Captain Dave Carraro finds himself questioning his own abilities, and lashing out at others as a result. He’s desperate for an opportunity to redeem himself in the eyes of the fleet, his crew and, most of all, himself. And Captain Paul Hebert doubles down on his efforts to train his rookie mate, but his hardline methods could make matters worse.

It's the mid-point of the Atlantic Bluefin tuna season, and it's the opportunity for captains to take stock in how their season has gone so far. For boats atop the fleet, it's time to keep up their hard work. Meanwhile, boats on the bottom know they must push harder yet if they're going to save their season and make any money this summer.

The battle for first place in the fleet rages on, as two captains separate themselves from the pack, leaving a trail of cash-strapped competitors in their wake. Meanwhile, the competition turns desperate for some captains, who are feeling the pressure to land a paycheck. With just a few weeks left in the season, Gloucester’s best fishermen need to turn their luck around or risk going home broke.

With just a few weeks left in the season, the Gloucester fleet knows that Captain Dave Carraro is a formidable opponent, and one captain conspires to get under Carraro’s skin in the hopes of gaining a competitive advantage. The plot succeeds, and when Carraro opts to dock his boat for a few days, the other captains pounce on the chance to take the lead away from him.

A good mate can make or break a captain’s season. Nick “Duffy” Fudge makes a mistake that could destroy the Pinwheel’s chances of catching a fish, causing tempers to flare and tensions to boil over. Meanwhile, Captain Dave Marciano of the Hard Merchandise and Captain Brad Krasowski of the Fish Hawk continue to trail behind the fleet and are desperate to catch bluefin and turn their luck around.

A treacherous storm descends on Gloucester, forcing captains to choose between risking their lives battling the elements or risking missing out on a catch. With just three weeks left in the season, the captains are feeling the pressure. But as conditions become dangerous, landing a fish is more challenging than ever. With great risk comes great reward, but which captains will be up to the test?

With just two weeks left in the season, Captains Dave Carraro and Tyler McLaughlin are locked in a heated battle for first place, and each is determined to win. Meanwhile, Captains Dave Marciano and Brad Krasowski are just trying to make a paycheck — and the pressure to bring home a fish is more intense than ever before. Paul Hebert suffers an injury that threatens to end his season.

The captains of Gloucester have one last chance to put meat on deck before the season ends. For some, a single fish can be the difference between a much-needed paycheck or going home broke. Captain Tyler McLaughlin is within striking distance of becoming this year’s champion, but will a sudden setback at sea derail his chances? It’s a race to the finish where only one captain can win.
